front.title: Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) Hooks: An HTTP-Based Protocol for External Mail Processing

abstract.t: This document specifies MTA Hooks, an HTTP-based protocol that lets Mail Transfer Agents (MTAs) delegate message processing decisions to external services. The MTA sends a JSON or Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) description of the SMTP session, envelope, and message to a registered service at defined stages of reception and delivery. The service answers with a JSON Patch that changes the description, and the MTA acts on the resulting state. The same mechanism covers filtering at SMTP time, routing before delivery, and reacting to delivery outcomes, and the MTA controls exactly which changes each service may make.
